instructions:
IMPORTANT: Replace the placeholder values above with your actual OAuth 2.0 Client ID credentials. 
1. Go to the Google Cloud Console (https://console.cloud.google.com/). 
2. Create a new project or select an existing one. 
3. Enable the 'Google Drive API' for your project. 
4. Go to 'Credentials' and create an 'OAuth 2.0 Client ID'. 
5. Select 'Desktop app' as the Application type. 
6. Name your client (e.g., 'NoteTakingAppClient'). 
7. Download the JSON file and replace this file ('credentials.json') with its content.
